title: Check Stripe account requirement for Polar.sh

userPrompts.text: do I need to create a stripe account before creating a Polar.sh account?
Should I use Polar.sh or Lemon Squeezy?

firstResponse: No, you don't need a pre-existing Stripe account. Polar.sh uses Stripe Connect under the hood, and their onboarding flow guides you through creating/connecting a Stripe account as part of the Polar.sh setup process — you do it all from within Polar.sh. That said, my knowledge cuts off August 2025 and Polar.sh's onboarding flow may have changed. Check their current docs at polar.sh for the latest steps.
